title: Stock is held at confirm and released when payment does not complete

card.i_want: stock to be held the moment an order is confirmed and released if payment does not follow
card.so_that: no customer ever pays for something the shelf does not have

intent: The merchant can promise availability at the moment of purchase, which is the zero-overselling quality KPI and the reason customers trust the channel.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: stock is reserved at confirm and not at add-to-cart
given: a product with 5 units available and a customer holding one in a cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer confirms an order for 1 unit
then: before the confirm the availability was unchanged at 5

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: an expired reservation returns its units
given: a reservation created 30 minutes ago with no payment result
then: the reserved units return to available

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a reservation just short of the expiry still holds
then: the payment succeeds and the units convert to sold

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: two confirms for the last unit produce exactly one winner
given: a product with exactly 1 unit available
two customers confirming for that unit at the same moment
then: exactly one order is created and reserved
the other customer is refused at confirm with the neutral out-of-stock message

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: stock never goes negative under concurrent confirms
given: any number of concurrent confirms against one product
then: available is never negative at any observable point
the sum of available, reserved and sold equals the physical count

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a cancelled-before-payment order releases its hold
given: an order in awaiting-payment with reserved units
then: the reserved units return to available and the order moves to cancelled

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: sold units cannot be released by an expiry
given: units already converted to sold by a successful payment
acceptance_criteria.when: a stale reservation-expiry job fires for that order
then: the sold units are not returned to available
an audit event records the product, the signed delta, the cause and the time

pii_fields.justification: stock quantities are per product and identify no person

audit_events.justification: every reserve, release and conversion must be reconstructable when counts drift

idempotency.justification: a repeated reserve or a stale expiry must not double-move units
idempotency.treatment: reservation identity keyed to the order line

reversibility.justification: a reservation is released on failure, timeout or cancellation
reversibility.compensating_action: return the reserved units to available

authn_authz.justification: only a confirm by the owning customer may reserve against their order

regulatory.justification: inventory holding is not itself a regulated activity in this scope

tipping_off.justification: the out-of-stock message a losing customer sees is customer-facing copy
tipping_off.treatment: neutral wording reviewed by Legal and UX

cases_written: reserve at confirm and not at add-to-cart
edge_case_ledger.justification: the rule fixes when a hold is taken, not a quantity boundary
expiry is a system action with no actor to get wrong
all derivations for a state-transition rule of this shape were written
all derivations for a constraint of this shape were written

cases_written: two confirms for the last unit
edge_case_ledger.justification: the rule is about contention resolution, and its quantity boundary is covered by RULE-STOCK-04
